properties.name: Auchtertool (Cato), Fife
properties.verification: Figures as reported by APRS; not yet checked against planning documents.

sources.title: APRS map of proposed data centres in Scotland

properties.notes: Farmland by Auchtertool. APRS reports a newly built battery energy storage system next to the site, that the council is screening for EIA, and that the submitted plans show buildings over Hallyards Castle.
properties.model_bbox_note: 3.2 × 1.6 km (east–west × north–south) centred on the APRS pin; a modelling extent, not a site boundary.
properties.model_bbox_wide_note: Study area of JC's Mossmorran/Auchtertool terrain build (Nov 2026), taking in the Mossmorran plant.

turbines.source: Fife Council planning register, amendment to permission 11/04794/EIA (Clentrie/Gevens; REPD 4078): tip height 99.9 m, rotor diameter 82 m; hub height = tip - rotor/2. The original design was an Enercon E70 (hub 64 m, rotor 71 m; energymap.co.uk); which was built is not confirmed.
